name: DROSPYRENONE / ETHINYLESTRADIOL 21 TABLETS
description: The combination of drospirenone and ethinylestradiol in 21 tablets is a combined hormonal contraceptive used primarily to prevent pregnancy. It is available in various brands and formats, and its use involves taking one pill daily for 21 days, followed by a 7-day break. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
